purpose: Independent classical-MD check (EAM) of the GB10's MACE melting point and latent heat.
status: inputs only; NOT submitted. Ask Madhan before submitting any Nebius job.
engine: LAMMPS (needs the MANYBODY package: check `lmp -h | grep -i eam` on the Nebius image)

potential.citation: Y. Mishin, D. Farkas, M.J. Mehl, and D.A. Papaconstantopoulos (1999), "Interatomic potentials for monoatomic metals from experimental data and ab initio calculations", Physical Review B 59(5), 3393-3407.
caveats: NIST's own iprPy two-phase estimate for this implementation is 1040.41 +/- 1.04 K (fcc), +11.5% vs the measured 933.45 K, i.e. just outside the +/-10% tier1 gate. If our run agrees, this potential is not a usable check for Al. Context only; it does not set the bracket.
The abstract (as listed on NIST) does not name the melting point among the fitted or reproduced properties; the paper's fitting database itself was not checked.

fingerprint_check.source: release notes (SOLD vs LAMMPS minimum energy)

nist_computed_melting_K.method: NIST iprPy melting_temperature (two-phase, NPH + Berendsen, 200,000 steps)

structure.source: coolorbit/sim/alloys.py ELEMENT_CRYSTALS (Donohue, The Structures of the Elements, 1974; alpha-Ga: Sharma & Donohue 1962). Starting lattice constants; NPT relaxes them.

melting_point_guess.use: ONLY to place the temperature bracket. Not a reference value: the calibration references live in data/calibration/ (Teammate 1).

jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Al-coexist-T746.8.lammps -var T 746.8 -var Tprep 933.5 -var Tmelt 2800.5 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Al-coexist-T840.1.lammps -var T 840.1 -var Tprep 933.5 -var Tmelt 2800.5 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Al-coexist-T933.5.lammps -var T 933.5 -var Tprep 933.5 -var Tmelt 2800.5 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Al-coexist-T1026.8.lammps -var T 1026.8 -var Tprep 933.5 -var Tmelt 2800.5 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Al-coexist-T1120.1.lammps -var T 1120.1 -var Tprep 933.5 -var Tmelt 2800.5 -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_Al-latent-solid.lammps -var phase solid -var T TM_MEAM_K -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_Al-latent-liquid.lammps -var phase liquid -var T TM_MEAM_K -var seed 2026

latent.protocol: solid vs liquid enthalpy at Tm

analysis.latent: python ../analyze.py latent h_solid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat h_liquid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat --log-solid log_Al-latent-solid.lammps --log-liquid log_Al-latent-liquid.lammps

if_bracket_missed: all melting -> shift the bracket down by 20%; all freezing -> up by 20% (same rule as the GB10 Simulator), then refine around the crossover with 4 temperatures 2% apart.
